lines.trans: Chef, some young woman is calling for you over there.
Who is she and what does she need?
She said that she came from television.
I do not want to talk to anyone.
She says that the matter is very important.
I currently have absolutely no time.
She is waiting for you near the main entrance.
Let her come into my office.
She asked you to come out for one minute.
Fine, Kostya, I will come over myself now.
Thank you, chef, I will convey your words.
And pour me some strong black tea.
Of course, chef, I will do it right now.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
I'm listening right by my ear.
The car is parked near the house.

examples.text: Возле дома Аникеева ходили два подозрительных человека.
examples.trans: Near Anikeev's house two suspicious people were walking.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.
There at the cemetery is the main entrance.
Where is the entrance to the metro?
We will open this entrance right now.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go out, to get out', paired with 'выходить'.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun
neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
The most important thing is the people.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

зайти.gloss: to come in, to drop in

meanings.en: to come in, to step in

examples.trans: I'll drop by in the evening.

examples.text: Ну, как хочешь. Лидия Алексеевна, зайдите, пожалуйста!
examples.trans: Well, as you like. Lidia Alekseyevna, come in, please!

meanings.note: звать на помощь = to call for help
как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...
emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: a person's own room at work

examples.text: Николай Филиппович, я сейчас в кабинете у мэра.
examples.trans: Nikolai Filippovich, I'm in the mayor's office right now.

meanings.note: declines like какой: какая-то, какое-то, какие-то

examples.text: Бред какой-то. Но, с другой стороны, чем я рискую?
examples.trans: What nonsense. But on the other hand, what have I got to lose?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

examples.text: Рука у тебя крепкая, как у деда.
examples.trans: Your grip is strong, just like your grandfather's.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'minute' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I'll be there in ten minutes.

examples.text: Ладно, будь там. Через десять минут буду.
examples.trans: All right, stay there. I'll be there in ten minutes.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: налей мне чаю = pour me some tea; налей мужу = pour your husband a drink

examples.trans: Nina, pour your husband a drink. We've got something to celebrate!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
+ genitive: ни копейки = not a penny

examples.text: Пятьсот. А у меня ни копейки.
examples.trans: Five hundred. And I haven't got a penny.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.

examples.text: Всё, я ухожу. Ребёнок ни при чём. Передай это Алексею.
examples.trans: That's it, I'm leaving. The child isn't to blame. Give this to Alexei.

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach

examples.text: Нам не нужна ваша приставка! Ещё раз подойдёте к моему ребёнку — пожалеете!
examples.trans: We don't need your console! Come near my child again and you'll be sorry!
Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!
examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

examples.text: В смысле, Виктор Степанович? Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Viktor Stepanovich? Just like that?

meanings.note: + 3rd person verb: 'пусть строят' = let them build

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word
'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.
This is a completely new car.

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города. И предложение у меня к вам такое.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town. And my offer to you is this.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I
там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'television' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Телевидение покажет сюжет про вашу дружную семью.
examples.trans: Television will show a story about your united family.

examples.text: Ты будешь выступать на телевидении, Виктор.
examples.trans: You will perform on television, Viktor.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.note: partitive genitive чаю is common: чашка чаю

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.
Now I'll make some tea too.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('black').

examples.trans: Listen, look in the black cabinet.

examples.text: На нём был строгий чёрный костюм.
examples.trans: He was wearing a formal black suit.

examples.text: Как не нашла? Послушай, в чёрном шкафу посмотри. Там справа от двери!
examples.trans: What do you mean you didn't find it? Listen, look in the black cabinet. There to the right of the door!
The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
